title: Primitive quotient pullback model existence
statement: For a prime ell, a finite coefficient field E, a scheme map f:X -> Y with ell invertible in every residue field of X and Y, a supplied coefficient derived-system calculus S on Y and a supplied normalized Roos model rho on X, there exists an IntegralComparisonPullbackModel for f,S,rho [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]: a natural isomorphism from the actual completed integral pullback to reduction followed by sequence inverse image and total derived limit, with its fixed strict generator and Roos normalization on every whole-system coherent simultaneous quotient presentation of every flat-term K-flat complex.

source.place: Tags 099N(2),(5), 06YS, 0G7E and 0941; pullback/scalar model existence split from lem-trf-primitive-quotient-realization-comparisons

proof.text: Choose the ordinary quotient model and its compatible derived comparison to the supplied calculus. Obtain the strict ordinary pullback tower comparison.

Compose the derived reduction comparison, the exact inverse-image/restriction factorization isomorphisms of the whole-system sequence pullback and coefficient restriction, the supplied natural Roos comparison, and the strict tower comparison. These give a natural isomorphism on the good flat-term K-flat class. The existing uniqueness clause of integralOperationsWellDefined extends it to the ambient derived category and fixes its good-complex components.

For any coherent presentation use the strict quotient isomorphism a from the first lemma and set q to the pullback of a inverse followed by the tower comparison. The second lemma gives its generator equation. Naturality of the combined restriction/Roos comparison and D.reductionComparison followed by Q(a) equal to e allow cancellation of a and a inverse inside Roos. The remaining equation is precisely the localization uniqueness equation.

proof_origin.place: Actual Lean assembly via strict quotient comparison, supplied natural Roos comparison, and integralOperationsWellDefined uniqueness. Pullback normalization is repaired to require a whole-system coherent presentation; see coord/changes/S9-pullback-presentation-coherence.md.

lean.statement:
theorem primitiveQuotientPullbackModelExistence
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (_hlX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.residueField x))
    (_hlY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.residueField y))
    (SY : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E Y)
    (ρX : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l E X) :
    Nonempty (IntegralComparisonPullbackModel l E f SY ρX)
